firearmspecs:
{{doc-special|FirearmSpecs}}
Title of the special page where users try the parser on product titles.
firearmspecs-form-titles:
Label of the text box for product titles on [[Special:FirearmSpecs]].

Parameters:
* $1 - the most titles read at once (50)
firearmspecs-form-kind: Label of the product type menu on [[Special:FirearmSpecs]].
firearmspecs-form-kind-guess: Option of the product type menu on [[Special:FirearmSpecs]]: the parser decides from the title whether it is a firearm or ammunition.
firearmspecs-form-submit: Label of the submit button on [[Special:FirearmSpecs]].
firearmspecs-results: Heading above the results table on [[Special:FirearmSpecs]].
firearmspecs-results-truncated:
Warning on [[Special:FirearmSpecs]] when more titles were submitted than are read.

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of titles read
firearmspecs-results-usage: Text below the results table on [[Special:FirearmSpecs]]. Explains how to use the parser function on wiki pages. Do not translate {{#firearmspecs: or caliber.
firearmspecs-footer:
Credit line at the bottom of [[Special:FirearmSpecs]]. The data license (CC BY 4.0) requires this credit.

Parameters:
* $1 - version of the gunsnprices library, such as 0.1.0
firearmspecs-col-title:
Column header on [[Special:FirearmSpecs]]: the product title that was read.
{{Identical|Title}}
firearmspecs-spec-brand:
Label of the brand in the specs table. Shown as plain text.
{{Identical|Brand}}
firearmspecs-spec-model:
Label of the firearm model in the specs table. Shown as plain text.
{{Identical|Model}}
firearmspecs-spec-caliber: Label of the caliber (cartridge) in the specs table. Shown as plain text.
firearmspecs-spec-capacity:
Label of the magazine capacity in the specs table. Shown as plain text.
{{Identical|Capacity}}
firearmspecs-spec-barrel: Label of the barrel length in the specs table. Shown as plain text.
firearmspecs-spec-rounds: Label of the number of rounds in one box of ammunition, in the specs table. Shown as plain text.
firearmspecs-spec-costperround: Label of the price of one round of ammunition, in the specs table. Shown as plain text.
firearmspecs-kind-firearm: Product type: a firearm. Shown in the specs table and in the product type menu of [[Special:FirearmSpecs]]. Shown as plain text.
firearmspecs-kind-ammo: Product type: ammunition. Shown in the specs table and in the product type menu of [[Special:FirearmSpecs]]. Shown as plain text.
firearmspecs-rounds:
A number of rounds (cartridges): the magazine capacity of a firearm, or the number of rounds in a box of ammunition. Shown as plain text.

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of rounds
firearmspecs-unit-in:
A barrel length in inches. Shown as plain text.

Parameters:
* $1 - the length, such as 16.5
firearmspecs-unit-cm:
A barrel length in centimeters. Shown as plain text.

Parameters:
* $1 - the length, such as 41.9
firearmspecs-unit-mm:
A barrel length in millimeters. Shown as plain text.

Parameters:
* $1 - the length, such as 419
firearmspecs-costperround-value:
The price of one round of ammunition, in the specs table. Shown as plain text.

Parameters:
* $1 - the price with its currency symbol, such as $0.38
firearmspecs-error-library: Error shown by the parser functions and on [[Special:FirearmSpecs]] when the PHP library the extension needs is missing. Shown as plain text: wiki markup is not read. Do not translate "gunsnprices/gunsnprices", "composer install --no-dev" or "extensions/FirearmSpecs".
firearmspecs-error-field:
Error of a parser function when the field name is not known. Shown as plain text.

Parameters:
* $1 - the field name that was given
* $2 - comma-separated list of valid field names
firearmspecs-error-kind: Error of {{#firearmspecs:}} when the kind option is not known. Shown as plain text. Do not translate "firearm" or "ammo". Parameters: * $1 - the kind that was given
firearmspecs-error-unit: Error of {{#firearmspecs:}} when the unit option is not known. Shown as plain text. Do not translate "in", "cm" or "mm". Parameters: * $1 - the unit that was given
firearmspecs-error-price:
Error of a parser function when the price is not a number. Shown as plain text.

Parameters:
* $1 - the price that was given
firearmspecs-error-decimals:
Error of a parser function when the decimals option is not a whole number from 0 to 4. Shown as plain text.

Parameters:
* $1 - the value that was given
firearmspecs-error-rounds: Error of {{#costperround:}} when the second parameter (a round count or a product title) is missing. Shown as plain text.
